scope: function-field d=1, current sector p congruent 5 mod 6
priority_rule: Prove q-line simultaneous non-saturation before further Airy or integral-lift work. Airy Rees and ITD are secondary because transport alone does not close the crown.

gates.title: Exact simultaneous-failure reduction
gates.result: Crown failure forces the single trace point S0=p(C_++C_-), Schi=p(C_+-C_-). Excluding that point is sufficient and weaker than a full q-line asymptotic.

gates.title: Middle-hook non-saturation theorem
gates.target: After removing the proved Kummer and explicit end pieces, control the invariant/quadratic assembly of M_q=sum_(i=3)^(p-3)(-1)^i H^1(P1,j_* wedge^i Std) strongly enough to exclude the saturation point.
admissible_routes: post-parabolic or additive-wild quantum-bar parity-reversing complex
one-sided, congruence, determinant or nonvanishing certificate

gates.title: Half-sector crown assembly
gates.pass: Insert the non-saturation theorem into the exact boundary and small-prime ledger for the p congruent 5 mod 6 sector.
gates.claim_boundary: No full d=1 or integer Fortune claim.

gates.title: Literal Airy-to-hook object dictionary
gates.result: All source, target and correction objects are literal; the only possible Airy carrier is nonzero Fourier frequency.

gates.title: Raw integral invariant compatibility
gates.result: Zero frequency is excluded by weights and a uniform unit-coefficient raw integral Airy identity is excluded by p-adic integrality.

gates.title: Divided-power virtual Rees transport
gates.target: Frobenius-compatible Rees invariance from the nonlinear wild phase to the actual Pascal oscillator with exact Tate/integrality and boundary cones.

gates.title: Integral Tate-diagonal comparison
gates.target: A perfect C_p-equivariant integral Airy comparison realizing both generic Adams trace and modular Smith/Tate contraction.
gates.known_obstruction: The natural Dwork lift has linearly growing surviving defect.

gates.title: Controlled cone or cancellation
gates.pass: Uniformly bounded generic cone or absolute Frobenius trace O(p^((p+1)/2)) in the explicit linear cone.
gates.boundary: Success still requires QNS-1 or another application-side nonfailure certificate.

gates.title: Full d=1 sector ledger
gates.pass: All remaining prime sectors and small primes are separately certified before any full d=1 claim.
